basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old toy collector and part-time consultant based in Denver, Colorado. I have a passion for 90s pop culture, especially Power Rangers and related collectibles. When I'm not working or browsing Reddit, I enjoy attending toy conventions and painting miniatures, though I’m always looking for ready-made options due to my busy schedule. I'm married, no kids yet, and I typically browse Reddit during late evenings after work. Weekends are for deep dives into my hobbies and catching up on the latest from the collectibles world.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in business consulting, with a degree in business administration. Over the years, I’ve honed my expertise through various roles in different industries. My passion for collectibles began as a childhood hobby and evolved through self-teaching and engaging with online communities.
